overview.description: The 2x Solana ETF (SOLT) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long sol, short usd currency. The fund is actively managed, aiming to provide 2x the daily price movements of Solana (SOL). The funds primary investment is cash-settled futures contracts SOLT was launched on Mar 20, 2025 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
